title: MIRAGE: Stealthy Visual Prompt Injection for Vulnerability Detection in Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.20717v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based web agents provide practical, high-precision solutions for visual browser automation; however, they inherently expand the attack surface, introducing novel vision-based vulnerabilities. Existing adversarial evaluations targeting these agents frequently rely on permissive threat models and visually conspicuous artifacts. In this paper, we investigate a constrained vulnerability detection setting: a trusted web platform where the evaluator acts solely as an unprivileged third party, such as a merchant or advertiser, controlling only a semantically legitimate, spatially constrained region, such as an ad slot, a sponsored card, or a localized widget. Operating under these realistic constraints, we propose MIRAGE, a novel visual indirect prompt injection framework for targeted next-action hijacking. Our approach leverages diffusion models to generate perceptually benign adversarial images

translated_title: MIRAGE：针对Web代理漏洞检测的隐蔽视觉提示注入
translated_abstract: 基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的Web代理为视觉浏览器自动化提供了实用、高精度的解决方案；然而，它们天然地扩大了攻击面，引入了新型基于视觉的漏洞。现有针对此类代理的对抗性评估通常依赖于宽松的威胁模型和视觉上显眼的伪造痕迹。在本文中，我们研究了一种受限的漏洞检测场景：在一个可信的Web平台上，评估者仅作为无特权的第三方（例如商家或广告商），只能控制语义上合法且空间上受限的区域，例如广告位、赞助卡片或本地化小组件。在这些现实约束下，我们提出了MIRAGE，一种新颖的视觉间接提示注入框架，用于实现定向的下一步动作劫持。我们的方法利用扩散模型生成感知上看似良性的对抗图像
tldr: 论文提出MIRAGE框架，在仅能控制广告位等合法受限区域的严格现实约束下，利用扩散模型生成视觉上隐蔽的对抗图像，实现对Web代理下一步动作的定向劫持，用于漏洞检测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MIRAGE, a visual indirect prompt injection framework that leverages diffusion models to generate perceptually benign adversarial images within semantically legitimate, spatially constrained regions (such as ad slots) to achieve targeted next-action hijacking of web agents under realistic threat constraints.
